VO_01_Enter: You are at the playground with your child. Take a moment to look around. Look at your child, the aunty on the bench, and the birthday party, in that order. Then go to the highlighted circle near the slide.
VO_02_Watch: Watch your child closely. Notice the changes in the sounds around him and the early signs in his body.
VO_02_Change: Something has changed. A balloon has popped and the music is louder. What do you notice in your child now?
VO_03_Clues: Open the clue tool on your left hand. Choose at least three different clues from the cards. Small signs can tell you a lot.
VO_04_Guesses: What might be going on? Open the guess tool. Choose a possible reason, then choose how sure you are. You can consider more than one idea.
VO_05_Respond: Go to the highlighted circle beside your child. Choose a response card, then watch how he reacts.
VO_05_Observe: Watch your child for a moment. Look for changes in his hands and body. Then review how sure you are about your guesses.
VO_06_ChildView: You are viewing the playground from your child's position. The sound and size changes are one possible illustration. Look toward the speaker and balloons, then return to your own view.
VO_07_Onlooker: Other people may interpret the scene differently. Look at the aunty on the bench and open her thought bubble. Her thought is an assumption, not a fact about your child.
VO_08_Reflect: Take a moment to reflect. Three questions will appear, one at a time. Spoken answers will be added later. For now, use the Skip button beside each question.
VO_09_Replay: Replay the scene once. The starting gazes will not repeat. Go to the observation circle. This time you can move freely and help your child before the balloon pops.
VO_09_EarlySigns: Look for the early signs. Before the loud noise, you can offer ear defenders or move your child to a quieter spot.
VO_10_Summary: Module one is complete. Compare what you noticed and how early you responded in the two attempts. This was the only replay. Thank you for taking part.
